method: Current official diocesan, patriarchal, government, and service records were used to establish named Eastern Orthodox bodies in Azerbaijan. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party or competent official sources. Unnamed rooms, communities without premises, uncertain current worship sites, noncanonical communities, and bodies outside the Eastern Orthodox communion were not converted into directory rows.

candidates.name: Two unnamed prison prayer rooms of the Baku Diocese
candidates.status: hold until each body is named by the competent diocese
candidates.reason: The current diocesan profile reports four prayer rooms at correctional institutions but names only the Saint Anastasia room at Institution No. 4 and the Saint George room at Institution No. 10. Those two named bodies are published. No names, institutions, or stable identities are inferred for the other two.

candidates.name: Unnamed Baku Diocese communities without worship premises
candidates.status: hold until a named body or recurring worship site is officially identified
candidates.reason: The diocese reports several communities without prayer premises and pastoral visits to believers on Pirallahi Island and in Sabirabad, Saatli, Qusar, and other districts. It does not name separate communities or identify recurring worship sites, so no body is inferred from the places visited.

candidates.name: Saint George Church at Kurmukhi
candidates.status: hold until current ordinary worship and canonical administration are established
candidates.reason: A Georgian government page describes the church as active and a 2022 official record documents a feast-day prayer service. The current four-church state roster used for publication does not include Kurmukhi, and no current competent Church roster establishes its ordinary operation or administrative placement. It remains held rather than duplicated or inferred.

candidates.name: Saint Nino Church at Qakh Alaverdi
candidates.local: კახის ალავერდის წმინდა ნინოს სახელობის ეკლესია
candidates.status: hold until current worship and canonical administration are established
candidates.reason: The Georgian Embassy identifies the church as present in Qakh District, but the current official four-church operating roster does not include it and no current competent Church source establishes worship or administrative control.

exclusions.result: The Republic of Azerbaijan registers the Alban-Udi communities as separate Christian religious communities. No competent canonical Eastern Orthodox synod identifies them as one of its dioceses, parishes, or missions. They are outside this Eastern Orthodox directory. This classification makes no judgment about their heritage or religious identity.

The Mother See of Holy Etchmiadzin lists an Armenian Diocese of Azerbaijan and identifies the Armenian Apostolic Church within the Oriental Orthodox family. It is therefore outside the Eastern Orthodox scope of this directory. No claim is made here about the current use or condition of individual Armenian church buildings.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current Baku and Azerbaijan Diocese profile reports seven parishes with churches, two chapels, four prison prayer rooms, and unnamed communities without premises. All eleven named bodies are published. Two unnamed prayer rooms and the unnamed communities remain held.

The competent regional evidence and official Azerbaijani operating roster identify four Georgian Orthodox churches at Qax Ingiloy, Alibayli, Kotuklu, and Meshabash. These four are published under the existing Georgian parent. Kurmukhi and Qakh Alaverdi remain held for current worship and administrative reconciliation.
The current official directory was checked and did not name an Azerbaijan body. This is a bounded roster result, not a country-level absence claim.
